Read tidy microbiome input files

mp_read_data.Rd

Reads the three tidy input files as character-typed tibbles (no validation, no type coercion) so mp_validate() can distinguish "not numeric" from "numeric" without prior silent coercion.

Usage

mp_read_data(feature_table_path, taxonomy_path, metadata_path)

Arguments

feature_table_path

Path to feature_table.tsv/.csv.

taxonomy_path

Path to taxonomy.tsv/.csv.

metadata_path

Path to metadata.tsv/.csv.

Value

A list with feature_table, taxonomy, metadata tibbles.
